newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH PLAYERS CRITICISED AFTER PAU PUNCH-UP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FRENCH PLAYERS CRITICISED AFTER PAU PUNCH-UP.

text.p: French club Pau were accused of losing their heads in a bad-tempered European Cup encounter against Welsh side Llanelli on Saturday which ended with three players being sent off.

Back-row forward Nicolas Bacque received his marching orders after 60 minutes for punching, Llanelli's Ieuan Jones followed as fighting continued and Pau scrum-half Frederic Torssian was also dismissed two minutes from time for stamping.
Llanelli coach Gareth Jenkins, whose side won the match 31-15, later blasted the French club's attitude.

"It's typical of the French mentality towards rugby when they are losing," he said. "They will do absolutely anything to stop you and that means fists and boots. They were delightful for the first 15 minutes but the last quarter of an hour was incredible. I was very, very disappointed with their actions."

As the players walked off the field there was further trouble with Pau's New Zealand flanker Scott Keith having to be pulled away from spectators after an altercation. French players mobbed English referee Steve Lander to complain.
